sentences.en: In a few seconds I would have overcome the desperation threshold.
sentences.zh: 几秒钟后，我就能克服绝望的心理门槛。

sentences.en: You start getting diminishing returns once you reach a certain threshold.
sentences.zh: 一旦达到某个临界点，回报就会递减。

sentences.en: He has never crossed the threshold of my house.
sentences.zh: 他从未踏入过我家的门檻。
